name: What types of bedroom night lights can be installed?

mainEntity.name: What types of bedroom night lights can be installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bedroom night lights come in various forms, including wall-mounted fixtures, recessed lights, plug-in options, and strip lighting. Wall-mounted lights offer ambient illumination and can be decorative. Recessed lights provide subtle, flush-to-the-wall lighting. Plug-in night lights are simple for temporary use. Strip lighting, often LED, can be installed under beds or along baseboards for a modern, diffused glow. The best type depends on your desired aesthetic, light intensity, and the room's existing electrical infrastructure.
